Hoàng Sa là nơi giá đất ven biển Đà Nẵng: Hoang Sa is currently where Da Nang coastal land prices are highest. Beachfront plots on the Man Thai – Pham Van Dong section are scarce, so small plots command even higher unit prices than large ones. 2026 listings: a 212 m² plot 10 m wide at about 70 billion VND (≈ 330 million VND/m²), a 213 m² plot at about 74.5 billion VND, a 327 m² plot 15 m wide at about 350 million VND/m²; two adjoining 205 m² plots opposite Man Thai beach are listed at up to about 415 million VND/m². Alley land near Hoang Sa is much cheaper, about 75 – 150 million VND/m².

Quỹ đất mặt biển nội thành gần như cố đị: The supply of beachfront land in the urban districts is almost fixed, so Da Nang coastal land prices for prime plots on Hoang Sa and Vo Nguyen Giap remain high; the areas with room left for owner-occupiers and mid-budget investors are Nguyen Tat Thanh (Lien Chieu) and the Lac Long Quan route toward Hoi An. Asking prices are only a starting point – review real transactions on the same section and the legal status of each plot before closing.

도심 구역의 해변 전면 토지 공급은 거의 고정되어 있어 호앙사 거리와 보응우옌잡 거리의 우수 필지는 다낭 해안 토지 가격이 계속 높은 수준을 유지합니다. 실거주자와 중간 규모 자본 투자자에게 아직 여지가 있는 지역은 응우옌떳타인 거리(리엔찌에우)와 호이안 방면 락롱꿘 축입니다. 호가는 출발점일 뿐이므로 계약 전에 같은 구간의 실거래와 필지별 법적 상태를 확인하시기 바랍니다.
Sau hợp nhất, trục biển nối Đà Nẵng – Hộ: After the merger, the coastal route linking Da Nang – Hoi An has the lowest Da Nang coastal land prices: 240 – 250 m² plots at about 31 – 46 million VND/m² (240 m² 6 m wide at about 7.4 billion VND; 252 m² in Cam An listed at 11.5 billion VND), large plots of 580 – 4,000 m² at about 16 – 30 million VND/m² (1,150 m² 32 m wide at about 33.5 billion VND). Listing addresses often mix up Dien Ngoc, Dien Duong and Cam An – check the location against the certificate and the zoning map.
